object.name: evi_korgms10
object.digest: 'Korg 35' single-amplifier unbuffered modified Sallen-Key topology nonlinear filter emulation
object.description: The 'Korg 35' chip was found in the MS-10 and early MS-20 synthesisers - different to the later dual-amplifier Korg OTA chip found in the later MS-20s and other Korg synthesisers.

inlets.name: resonance
inlets.digest: Filter resonance 0..1. As in the original analog circuit, lowpass output level is resonance dependent!

outlets.name: korg
outlets.digest: Main 12dB lowpass output. As in the original analog circuit, lowpass output level is resonance dependent!

outlets.name: bonus
outlets.digest: Quirky 12dB highpass output derived from Sallen Key states.

outlets.name: bonus
outlets.digest: Quirky 12dB bandpass output derived from Sallen Key states.

attributes.name: noiselevel
attributes.description: Amplitude level of gaussian noise recirculation in filter, 0..1 remapped 0.. 10% of gaussian level. Adding noise is not required for self oscillation, but for sound design.

attributes.name: oversample
attributes.description: If on (1) the filter is 2x oversampled. If off (0, the default), the filter runs at samplerate. Oversampling is recommended to deal with the nonlinear behaviour of the filter, but is expensive because of the multimode outputs.
